name: okfctl
description: Skills that drive okfctl, a command-line tool for Open Knowledge Format (OKF) bundles. Use them to add and rename nodes with the links kept intact, to check a bundle with validate and lint, to bring v0.1 and v0.2 bundles up to OKF v0.3 with migrate, and to find look-alike nodes with okfctl-search. You'll need the okfctl binary.

requires.reason: These skills shell out to the okfctl binary, which is NOT bundled by a plugin client. Install it onto PATH first.
